persons.name: Govinda Raghunātha Thaṭe
persons.evidence: govinda raghunātha thatene apane vanārasa akhavāra ke chāpekhāne me chapavāyā

relations.evidence: govinda raghunātha thatene apane vanārasa akhavāra ke chāpekhāne me chapavāyā || mī○ pauṣaśukla(7)10 saṃvat 1934 li○ raghuvīra pāṃḍe

purpose: for printing at the Banāras Akhbār press
notes: The catalogue records King Śrī 3 Mahārāja Raṇoddīpa Sīṃha Rāṇā and Donor Śrī 6 Rājagurudharmādhikāra Nagendrarāja Paṇḍita, but they do not appear in the quoted colophon. The manuscript copy was prepared for printing at Govinda Raghunātha Thaṭe's Banāras Akhbār printing press.
